description_zh: 调用CreateDISyncTask创建数据集成同步任务
name: CreateDISyncTask

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the data synchronization task. Valid values: DI_OFFLINE, DI_REALTIME, and DI_SOLUTION
parameters.help_zh:
创建的数据集成同步任务的任务类型。
目前支持使用CreateDISyncTask接口创建数据集成离线同步任务（DI_OFFLINE），实时同步任务（DI_REALTIME）和解决方案（DI_SOLUTION）
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The script content of the data synchronization task
parameters.help_zh: 数据集成同步任务的脚本内容
parameters.name: task_content

parameters.help_en:
The configuration parameters of the data synchronization task. The following parameters are supported:

FileFolderPath: the storage path of the data synchronization task.

ResourceGroup: the identifier of the resource group for Data Integration that is used by the data synchronization task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html operation to query the identifier of the resource group.

Cu: the specifications occupied by the data synchronization task in the serverless resource group. The value of this parameter must be a multiple of 0.5
parameters.help_zh:
数据集成同步任务的配置参数。目前支持配置如下参数：
FileFolderPath：表示数据集成同步任务的存放路径。
ResourceGroup：表示数据集成同步任务所使用的数据集成资源组标识（Identifier）。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173913.html，获取资源组标识。
Cu：表示数据集成同步任务在Serverless资源组上占用的规格，必须是0.5的倍数
parameters.name: task_param

parameters.help_en: The name of the data synchronization task
parameters.help_zh: 创建的数据集成同步任务的名称
parameters.name: task_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. This parameter can be left empty
parameters.help_zh: 幂等参数，该参数可为空
parameters.name: client_token

Data.description_en: The information that indicates whether the data synchronization task is created
Data.description_zh: 创建数据集成同步任务的返回结果

FileId.description_en: The ID of the data synchronization task that is created
FileId.description_zh: 成功创建的数据集成同步任务的任务ID

Message.description_en: The error message that is returned if the data synchronization task fails to be created. If the data synchronization task is successfully created, this parameter is not returned. If the data synchronization task fails to be created, an error message in the "Invalid path: Workflow/xxxx/Data Integration" format is returned
Message.description_zh: 创建数据集成同步任务失败的原因描述，如果成功，该字段为空，如果不成功，实例如下"不合法的目录路径：业务流程/xxxx/数据集成"，

Status.description_en:
The creation status of the data synchronization task. Valid values:

success

fail
Status.description_zh:
创建数据集成同步任务的结果状态。取值如下：
success：表示创建任务成功。
fail：表示创建任务失败

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
